description: Source code implementing UDP socket operations for QUIC protocol on POSIX systems, including socket creation, configuration, packet reading/writing, and control message handling.

classes.name: LinuxSoTimestamping
classes.description: Structure for Linux timestamping information used in control messages.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a UDP socket with specified address family and buffer sizes.

methods.name: SetupSocket
methods.description: Configures socket options such as buffer sizes, ECN, and self IP reception.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the socket.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds socket to a specified address.

methods.name: BindInterface
methods.description: Binds socket to a specific network interface (platform-specific).

methods.name: EnableReceiveSelfIpAddressForV4
methods.description: Enables reception of self IPv4 address.

methods.name: EnableReceiveSelfIpAddressForV6
methods.description: Enables reception of self IPv6 address.

methods.name: EnableReceiveTtlForV4
methods.description: Enables reception of TTL for IPv4.

methods.name: EnableReceiveTtlForV6
methods.description: Enables reception of hop limit for IPv6.

methods.name: WaitUntilReadable
methods.description: Blocks until socket is readable or timeout occurs.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.description: Reads a single UDP packet and associated control messages.

methods.name: ReadMultiplePackets
methods.description: Reads multiple UDP packets, optionally using recvmmsg on Linux.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a UDP packet with optional control messages such as ECN, TTL, and self IP.
